other_conditions: The applicant must have a disability of at least 40%.
The applicant must be a resident of Union Territory of Chandigarh for more than 3 years.
Family annual income must not exceed ₹1.5 lakh.
benefits_summary: A pension of ₹1000 per annum for 40‑70% disability and ₹2000 per annum for more than 70% disability.
